name: LRB-3-pass
definition: A constant-memory reverse-mode differentiable light tracing method that introduces an additional traversal to accumulate downstream adjoint contributions prior to backpropagation, retaining all connections and matching naive reverse-mode AD in expectation.
summary: LRB-3-pass is a constant-memory differentiable light tracing method that uses three path traversals to compute exact gradients without variance, distinguishing it from reservoir-based approximations.
